description:
Welcome to Best Buy Boxes, your go-to destination for high-quality, hand-selected goods. We're a team of passionate shoppers who are dedicated to bringing you the best products from around the world.

Our mission is simple: to curate a selection of the finest products across various categories, including home goods, beauty, fashion, tech, Hobby & Toys and more. We pride ourselves on our commitment to quality, ensuring that each item we feature meets our rigorous standards.

We understand that shopping online can be overwhelming, which is why we take the guesswork out of the equation. Our expert team scours the globe to find the most innovative and stylish products, so you can shop with confidence.

At Best Buy Boxes, we believe that everyone deserves access to the best products available. That's why we offer our selection at affordable prices, without sacrificing on quality.

We're excited to have you here and can't wait for you to discover your new favorite products. Thanks for choosing Best Buy Boxes!

term_and_condition:
Welcome to BestBuyBoxes! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

When a customer you refer completes an eligible purchase on our website, you will earn a commission based on the applicable commission structure. Commissions are calculated using the qualifying product value of the order and exclude taxes, shipping charges, and other additional fees.

To receive commission payments, you must provide complete and accurate payment details on the Settings page of your affiliate account. Missing or incorrect payment information may delay your payment.

Payment Schedule

Our finance team processes affiliate commission payments only between the 1st and 5th of each month. Payments are not processed outside this period.

  • Approved commission balance of US$50 or more: Your full available commission balance will be paid automatically. No action is required. Please wait for the payment confirmation during the payment period.
  • Approved commission balance below US$50: If you would like to receive your commission, please email us between the 1st and 5th of the month to request payment. Requests submitted outside this period will not be processed.

Commission payments are issued only for eligible referral orders that have been successfully completed. We reserve the right to review every referral and order for validity and compliance with our Affiliate Program rules.

Orders that are cancelled, refunded, disputed, or charged back are not eligible for commission. Any commission associated with such an order may be cancelled or reversed.

You can view the status of your commissions under the Commission tab. Completed commission payments will be listed under the Payment tab.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: bestbuyboxes@gmail.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to bestbuyboxes@gmail.com for support.
